thread:
maria_ux: Quick check — noticed the inline docs snippets in the new dashboard behave differently than the right-side docs card. Clicking a heading scrolls the overlay but it doesn't set a URL fragment or deep-link. This breaks shareable links and our email jump-to anchors. Anyone else seen this?
jamal_pm: Repro'd on Chrome + Safari. The snippet opens the overlay but URL stays the same. If someone copies the link it won't land on the intended section.
alex_dev: Confirmed. The snippets are rendered by the tooltip injector and currently just call openOverlay(content). No history.pushState or fragment handling.
sarah_docs: Noticed a copy mismatch too: the snippet CTA says "Guide" while the docs site uses "Documentation" in headings. Small UX friction — users expect consistent terms.
maria_ux: Agreed on copy. Proposal: standardize on "Docs" everywhere (short + matches console nav). Also want fragment support so emails like https://console/redwood/models#quantization work.
alex_dev: Implementation plan: 1) add data-anchor attr on snippet links, 2) when opening overlay, if anchor present do history.pushState(null, '', `#${anchor}`) and focus the matching heading, 3) fallback parse ?jump_to=anchor for older links. Rough estimate: spike 1d, PR 2d.
samqa: QA caveats: when overlay opens via fragment, keyboard focus needs to move into the overlay and focus trap applied. We previously had a bug where focus stayed on the trigger. Also test back/forward behavior with pushState.
jamal_pm: Sounds reasonable. Priority: P2 for next sprint unless docs site deploy is blocked. Can we scope a minimal fix: fragment + aria-labels for screen readers, postpone fancy fallback?
sarah_docs: I'll rename headings in the docs repo to include stable ids (e.g., id="quantization") and update copy to "Docs" in the snippets content. I'll attach a PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
maria_ux: Accessibility note: snippet CTA should have aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the overlay region, and the overlay should announce the heading. Also include "opens Docs" in the accessible name.
alex_dev: Good call. I'll add aria attributes and a focus trap. For the fragment we can use this tiny handler: 
```
function openDocs(anchor){
  openOverlay();
  if(anchor){
    history.pushState(null, '', `#${anchor}`);
    const el = document.getElementById(anchor);
    if(el) el.focus();
  }
}
```
jamal_pm: Nice. Once alex has a draft PR, please tag @maria_ux @sarah_docs and @samqa for signoff. Also ping @eng-frontend in case of cross-app shared components.
eng-bot: Deployed branch/update-notification: none (waiting for PR).
maria_ux: One UX nit — can we add a micro tooltip on hover: "Opens Docs — jumps to section" to set expectations? Low effort, helps retention.
alex_dev: Will add that to the PR. I'll include a small A/B note in the PR description so UX can decide if tooltip stays.
sarah_docs: After I push the docs IDs, I'll add a small redirect rule for old anchors where feasible.
jamal_pm: Great sync. I'll add a ticket with the 3 acceptance criteria: fragments work, copy unified to "Docs", accessibility attributes + focus trap. Assign to alex_dev.
maria_ux: Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. Will follow up in the PR thread for copy signoff. :sparkles:
